Identity: enormous broad-shouldered hunched human brute, blunt rough face, bandaged head and bandaged long hairy muscular forearms and lower legs, dirty cream long-sleeved shirt, brown suspenders, torn brown trousers and heavy boots. One large rectangular stone brick held in the right hand. NO top hat, NO hunter coat, NO torch, NO axe, NO antlers. Recognizably the massive brick troll/minion, distinct from a thin top-hatted Huntsman.
Style: carefully painted semi-realistic dark gothic game sprites, convincing worn fabric, pale face and muted earthy tones, crisp readable silhouette and softly lit edges visible at 80px display height. Full body in every frame.
Atlas layout: square image, exact uniform 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, read left to right then top to bottom. Each frame completely isolated on REAL transparent alpha background, ample transparent gutter on all four sides inside every cell. No scene, floor, cast floor shadow, grid lines, cell borders, numbers, labels, lettering or watermark.
Fixed camera: same three-quarter front view facing screen right in every pose, same clothing, anatomy, brick, head size and body scale throughout. Each cell uses exactly the same foot pivot (horizontal center at 50 percent of cell width, ground line at 86 percent of cell height); no frame-to-frame lateral translation, flips or camera changes. Row4 frames12–15: first two cells recoil/hit then regain balance; last two cells knees buckling then lying collapsed with same clothing and brick, entire corpse inside its own cell.
